text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Christmas will be here soon—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Nishino Flower is always looking out for me.
I wanted to get her a gift this year to show my gratitude.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: —So, why come consult me about this?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
I'm just a student, you know.
I'm sure an adult Trainer like you could think up so much more.
choice_data_list: Still, you know Flower well, right?
Still, you know Flower really well, and...

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: "...Well, who can say? After all, aren't you the one who's always with her, Trainer?"

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
I really don't think I could come up
with a better idea than you~.
choice_data_list: We both care deeply for her, don't we?
We both care deeply for her, don't we?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Huh?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: "Over these past three years, I knew full well how much Seiun Sky cared for Nishino Flower."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
If Seiun Sky and I put our heads together,
we'll be able to make Nishino Flower much happier
than if I thought about it alone. That's why—

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: ...Such incredible passion.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
"Re~ally, they're two peas in a pod.
Which means next up, that girl will also..."

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Naw~?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
...No choice then!
Let's settle on you helping with my assignments for a week.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Yes, it's study time, study time.
Surely an adult wouldn't have any problem with that, right?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: "And in exchange, we get to borrow Sei-chan's wisdom. It's practically a steal, wouldn't you say?"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And so, together with Seiun Sky, I thought of ways to spend Christmas that would make Nishino Flower happy—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: —Having invited her, Christmas Day finally arrived.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Wah...!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Did you do all these decorations yourself,
Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Yes! It's super cute...♪

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The first surprise was decorating the room.
That seems to have been a success.
And next is the crucial—

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
...Hm?
Something smells really good...?

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Ah! Could it be...
you made food for us too!?

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: A big chicken, salad, soup... even grilled fish and seasoned greens!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The second—and main—surprise was a festive Christmas meal.
I also prepared Japanese dishes that Nishino Flower loves.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It might not compare to her delicious home cooking,
but I wanted to make her happy using the same kind of
kindness she always shows me.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Oh, no, I'm the one who should be thanking you!
I'm the one who has so many 'thank yous' to give!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: And so, today as well...

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: I wanted to surprise you too...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The present from Nishino Flower was a pair of knitted mittens
adorned with lovely flower appliqués.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
The cold days will keep going for a while, so
I knitted this hoping you'd wear it
when you're training outside.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Yes! My mom taught me
a little bit.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: I was secretly knitting it because I wanted to surprise you... but it looks like I was the one who ended up surprised instead.
choice_data_list: I was surprised too, thank you...!
I was surprised too, thank you...!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe, if you're pleased with it,
then I'm happy too...♪

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Still, I'm glad I consulted Sky-san about it.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
When I told them I wanted to serve up some cooking,
they suggested that maybe another way would be better this time.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
My mind was totally consumed by cooking, wasn't it?
Ehehe, that was a close one.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: It seems Nishino Flower also went for advice after I did. Did she take that into account when offering all those suggestions?
choice_data_list: I need to thank Seiun Sky too
I should thank Seiun Sky too

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: That's right!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Oh, right! Since we're here, why don't the two of us
put our heads together and surprise Sky-san?

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: I'm going to pull off a delightful surprise that'll put a huge smile on her face!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Then let's talk it over
while eating your cooking, Trainer♪

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Sky-san really loves cats.
Oh, and! She takes naps a lot too—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, while discussing surprise ideas with
Nishino Flower, we spent a fun Christmas night together.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: It seems Nishino Flower also went for advice after I did. Did she take that into account when offering all those suggestions?

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Wait, this lovely food's gonna get cold!
Let's relax and chat while we eat♪

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Everything looks so delicious!
Thank you for the food!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
âThank you so very much for the meal.
It was absolutely delicious!
choice_data_list: How was the seasoning? Was it okay?

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Yes! Every single dish was so delicious,
I could just keep eating them forever!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
"Could it be
you practiced a lot for this?"

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
"...I believe cooking reflects
the feelings of the person who made it."

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
"Today's meal had such a gentle, heartwarming flavor...
You could really taste the desire to 'make it delicious'
and 'bring joy to whoever eats it.'"

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: That's because, Trainer, you are so—
choice_data_list: That's just because you're so kind.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Huh?
Me?
choice_data_list: I tried to copy Flower's cooking.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
To match her tastes, I made it while remembering
the flavors of the bentos she always gives me.
Thinking back on it made me feel the depth of her affection once again.
choice_data_list: Thank you for always being so kind.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: ...Thank you very much from me as well.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Thank you so much...
for raising me with so much care up to this point!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: ...Ah, I forgot to mention!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Merry Christmas,
Trainer♪
